title: common: fix runtime_supports_nocgroup key name in docs
body:
The `[engine]` key for the list of OCI runtimes that support running containers without cgroups is `runtime_supports_nocgroup` (see the `toml` tag of `RuntimeSupportsNoCgroups` in `common/pkg/config/config.go`; it was last fixed in containers/common#408). The man page and both sample `containers.conf` files say `runtime_supports_nocgroups` instead, and that key is silently ignored, leaving the default value in effect.

Verified by loading a `containers.conf` via `CONTAINERS_CONF` and `config.New(nil)`:

```
runtime_supports_nocgroups = ["runc"]  ->  [crun krun]   (ignored, default used)
runtime_supports_nocgroup  = ["runc"]  ->  [runc]
```

Fix the docs and the sample configs. Changing the code instead would break existing configs using the working key name.
